columns:
George Odhiambo, owner, Pentagon View Investments, Shanzu, Mombasa
KCB FOUNDATION • George trained in carpentry at Mombasa Technical

CASE STUDIES
• Used KShs 100,000 2jiajiri funding to expand his

• Employs two and also offers apprenticeship to youth.
